shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions caused Bitcoin and altcoins to dip due to renewed uncertainty.
Despite cooler US inflation data reducing Fed hike odds, global concerns prevented a positive market reaction.
Crypto sentiment is in the "Fear" zone (index at 29), with Bitcoin ETFs experiencing over $60M in outflows.
Hyperliquid's HYPE token rallied, defying market trends, due to reports of potential US expansion.
